nodes.title: Pose loop indices
widgets_values:
# Pose loop guides (A → B → C → B → A)

Each guide pins ONE frame — any frame_idx works for single images (multiples of 8 are safest).

frames = duration × fps + 1 → default 5s × 25fps = 126:

| Pose | frame_idx |
|---|---|
| A (first) | 0 |
| B (mid 1) | 32 |
| C (peak) | 64 |
| B (mid 2) | 96 |
| A (last) | −1 |

Change duration/fps → recompute: quarter = frames//4, half = frames//2, 3/4 = 3×frames//4.

Strength 0.7 = workflow default; raise to 1.0 to pin a pose harder (less drift).
